title: OpenDEA Level Resolution Rule
description: LevelResolutionRule determines which level is achieved given evaluation outputs (CR-AM-09 §7). Canonical flow: Evidence → Native Evaluation → Native Score(s) → Progress Scoring Bands → Level Resolution Rule → Maturity Level. Highest-level resolution is expressible: a level is attributed only when all lower-level prerequisites AND its own conditions hold — a raw score never automatically represents accumulated maturity. The rule consumes exactly the inputs the MaturityEvaluationModel declares in level_resolution_inputs (conformance-asserted in the worked chain).

scale.description: The MaturityScale this rule resolves levels within.

evaluation_model.description: The MaturityEvaluationModel whose outputs this rule consumes.

band_set.description: The progress-scoring-band set this rule consults (band-mapping and highest-conformant-level strategies).

consumes.description: The evaluation-model outputs this rule consumes. Must match the evaluation model's level_resolution_inputs (conformance-enforced in the worked chain).

logic.description: The model-owned resolution logic, stated explicitly (e.g. the highest-conformant-level walk). Models own WHAT maturity means; the rule is where that meaning becomes an attribution.
